_comment: Glazed porcelain: the white, glass-glazed body of plates, cups, bowls and tiles. Opaque: a dielectric body under a clear, glossy glaze, the glaze carried as a coat (C2). Param-only (L1), authored white so a Creator's tint reaches every glaze colour. Carries the row's wear layers at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage) and fingerprints, gated by the Grime mask. The row's first layer, Crazing01, is not made yet; when it is, it takes slot 1 and the rest move down. Drafted by /matter-generate for the Kitchen_set look; Storm only, not rigged.
name: Porcelain_Glazed_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Physically Based's roughness 0 is the glaze's surface, carried here as the coat (weight 1, roughness 0.03, IOR 1.52, a soda-lime glass glaze). The body under it is a fired bisque, roughness 0.4.
